messages:
Maria: Quick triage — found audit logging coverage gaps across gateway, auth, console, billing, runtime. Need a small backlog we can ship in next two sprints. @Sam @Jin please review.

Sam: Can you paste the coverage snapshot you used? :eyes: 

Maria: snapshot:
```
api-gateway: missing request.identity, route.rewrite, upstream.fail
auth: missing token.rotate, session.invalidate, rbac.change
console: missing iam.view_keys, iam.create_policy, audit.search
billing: missing invoice.view, invoice.update_status, usage.aggregate
runtime: missing model.deploy, kvcache.evict, runtime.shutdown
```

Jin: runtime note — we muted kvcache.eviction on hot paths to reduce cardinality. Suggest sample-only lightweight events instead of full payloads.

Lee: console: iam.view_keys is customer-facing. Must redact HSM key ids and PII; include customer-visible resource id and actor.id.

Taylor: Support asks customers want a validator for SOC2 evidence. JSONL + JSON Schema validator seems fine.

Maria: proposal: Audit Event Schema v1.2 with fields: @timestamp, event_type, actor:{id,role}, resource:{type,id}, action, outcome, metadata. We'll publish a validator CLI (py/node) + JSON Schema + examples.

Sam: Add KMS events: kms.key.use, kms.rotate, kms.access_denied. Include key fingerprint and EKM id; never include raw key material.

Jin: example runtime event:
```
{
  "@timestamp":"2026-03-15T14:21:03Z",
  "event_type":"model.deploy",
  "actor":{"id":"svc-runtime","role":"system"},
  "resource":{"type":"model","id":"gpt-4x-rw"},
  "action":"deploy_attempt",
  "outcome":"success",
  "metadata":{"quant":"8bit","node":"r5g-2"}
}
```

Maria: owners: api-gateway -> Sam, auth -> Lee, console -> Taylor, billing -> Maria, runtime -> Jin. Each owner: create backlog ticket with sample events, schema mapping, integration test for happy-path emission + redaction.

Lee: RBAC: rbac.change should emit before/after minimal diffs (no policy dumps). Tie to admin id and request id and include request.origin.

Taylor: I'll build audit-validator CLI to validate JSONL exports, check redaction heuristics. Customers run locally; enterprise get hosted check.

Maria: timeline: owners add backlog stubs by EOD Fri; 2-day spike next week for schema/validator; ship PRs across Sprint A/B. Blockers? infra or KMS creds?

Sam: KMS creds: dev read-only exists. I'll open SEC ticket for org-level read access for test harness. Also adding sampling flag to gateway to reduce cardinality.

Jin: runtime needs sampling toggle emit reduced-metadata events. Filing PR to runtime toggles repo.

Taylor: I'll draft customer doc: how to export events, run validator, and package evidence for auditors.

auditbot: Automated: created SEC-4281 "Audit logging coverage backlog" and assigned to owners. Due: 2026-04-09.

Maria: retention & privacy: raw audit events hot 1y, cold 5y; mask tokens/keys; redact key material and PII. We'll run a mini dry run after PRs land. :thumbsup:

Sam: acceptance criteria: event emitted in prod-like env, JSON Schema validation, CI smoke test, privacy/redaction test, docs updated, sample export+validator run.

Lee: ping me for console UI design review.

Maria: OK. Sync 11am tomorrow in #eng-security. Reopen with PR links.
